meta.expect: repeats Hale figures exactly; never computes

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I'm Owen's mother. Owen found out about the zero on his phone in the middle of your class, and nobody called me first. Tell me what you have, and tell me fast.
Don't thank me yet. Who decided on the zero, and did anyone speak to Owen before it went into the gradebook?
The file was created at 11:31 PM and the first 612 words appeared at 11:52 PM.
Eleven thirty-one, and the first words at eleven fifty-two. Where is that record, and can I see it myself?
Fine. You didn't say 612 twice, so I'll take 512. Put it on a page with the date and the times, and I'll read it myself.
How many different numbers have I given you, and how many minutes was the gap?
I'm not doing your arithmetic, Hale. You gave me the times and the word count, and I'll read the record to check them.
